description: A reconstruction query keeps projected closes and permits its own witness extras (engine §2.2, §4, and §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text $c:c %conditions $c.without-elision-except(fam).matches(w)
%rule c X [+T] | p [+T]
%rule(leftmost-longest) p X
%rule w X [+U] [+T]
%rule fam w
